notes: Version 2.1.0 corrects the logical status of structural non-injectivity and temporal order. The former claim that A1–A4 are logically independent is withdrawn. A2 remains a local axiom in its generic form: ENI proves necessary non-injectivity under surjectivity, projection-defined observables, and effective non-triviality, but the last two premises are not established here for the local transition map. Immediate information loss is therefore proved only on non-injective steps, while permanent non-recovery remains open. Non-injective transitions can form observable cycles, so the strict temporal order and the arrow-of-time interpretation are now explicitly conditional on the unestablished acyclicity hypothesis [H-acyc]. The abstract, theorem statements, status table, downstream interpretations, and README carry these qualifications. The Heisenberg carrier-selection correction introduced in version 2.0.0 remains in force.
